intro: Slovenia is a small, export-driven economy and one of the richest of the former communist countries.

chapters.title: What Slovenia makes
text: Slovenia exports medicines, household appliances, cars and car parts, and its port of Koper serves much of Central Europe. Pipistrel, a Slovenian company, built the first fully electric aircraft certified for training pilots.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Tourists come for the Alps, lakes, caves and Ljubljana. The famous white Lipizzaner horses were first bred at Lipica in 1580.

keyTerms.meaning: An economy that relies heavily on selling goods abroad.
